conditions.heating_method: dissolution at elevated temperature (bei erhöhter Temperatur), where the crystals of modifications II and III are completely dissolved before cooling
conditions.cooling_method: cooling crystallisation to room temperature (Kühlungskristallisation zur Raumtemperatur), preferably at a cooling rate of less than 25°C and particularly preferably less than 20°C; the text prints no time unit for either rate

steps: separate off the crystals of crystal modification I obtained
dry at room temperature or elevated temperature to constant weight to remove the solvent
workup.filtration: crystals separated off (abgetrennt); the separation method is not stated

purification: solvent-mediated conversion to crystal modification I, the crystals then separated off and dried to constant weight

process_control.criterion: treated until quantitative conversion into the thermodynamically stable crystal modification I; no analytical method is named

compounds.addition_profile: optional seed crystals (Impfkristalle) of crystal modification I; when used, a treatment time of 24 to 48 hours is generally sufficient, and without them a suspension converts within a period of 14 days

procedure_text:
[0021] Die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione kann in allgemeiner Weise so hergestellt werden, dass man die nach WO 00/21924 erhältliche Kristallmodifikation II und III von Tembotrione beziehungsweise Gemische davon in einem geeigneten Lösungsmitteln suspendiert und/oder löst und bis zur quantitativen Umwandlung in die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation I bei Temperaturen von 0°C bis 80°C behandelt.
[0022] Ein weiterer Gegenstand der Erfindung ist somit ein Verfahren zur Herstellung der thermodynamisch stabilen Kristallmodifikation I von Tembotrione, wobei man die Kristallmodifikationen II und III von Tembotrione beziehungsweise Gemische davon in Lösungsmitteln suspendiert und/oder löst und bis zur quantitativen Umwandlung in die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation I bei Temperaturen von 0°C bis 80°C behandelt.
[0023] Geeignete Lösungsmittel, die in diesem Verfahren verwendet werden können, sind z.B. niedere Alkohole wie Methanol, Ethanol, 2-Propanol oder Ketone wie Aceton, 2-Butanon, die auch in Mischung mit Wasser verwendet werden können. Als niedere Alkohole bzw. Ketone werden hier solche Verbindungen bezeichnet, die eins bis zehn Kohlenstoffatome aufweisen, bevorzugt eins bis fünf Kohlenstoffatome. Weitere geeignete Lösungsmittel sind Benzol, Toluol und Chlorbenzol.
[0024] Die Umwandlung in die thermodynamisch stabile Kristallmodifikation I erfolgt bei Temperaturen kleiner 100°C, bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 0°C bis 80°C, besonders bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 60°C bis 80°C, ganz besonders bevorzugt bei Temperaturen von 50°C bis 80°C. Die Dauer der Umwandlung hängt ab von der Temperatur und der Art des Lösungsmittels. Weiterhin hängt die Dauer der Umwandlung davon ab, ob Impfkristalle der Kristallmodifikation I verwendet werden. Im Allgemeinen kann die Umwandlung zur Kristallmodifikation I bei vollständiger Auflösung der Kristalle der Kristallmodifikationen II und III beziehungsweise Gemischen davon bei erhöhter Temperatur durch Kühlungskristallisation zur Raumtemperatur ohne die Verwendung von Impfkristallen direkt erzielt werden. Das Abkühlen auf Raumtemperatur erfolgt vorzugsweise mit einer Kühlrate von kleiner 25°C, besonders bevorzugt mit einer Kühlrate von kleiner 20°C. Die Umwandlung einer Suspension von Kristallmodifikationen II und III beziehungsweise Gemischen davon kann in der Regel ohne die Verwendung von Impfkristallen in einem Zeitraum von 14 Tagen herbeigeführt werden. Werden bei der Umwandlung einer Suspension Impfkristalle der Kristallmodifikation I verwendet, ist im Allgemeinen eine Behandlungsdauer von 24 bis 48 Stunden ausreichend, um eine quantitative Umwandlung der Kristalle in die Kristallmodifikation I zu erreichen.
[0025] Die erhaltenen Kristalle der Kristallmodifikation I werden schließlich abgetrennt und zur Entfernung des Lösungsmittels bei Raumtemperatur oder erhöhter Temperatur bis zur Gewichtskonstanz getrocknet.
procedure_summary: The metastable crystal modifications of tembotrione, or mixtures of them, are suspended and/or dissolved in a lower alcohol, a ketone, an aromatic solvent or a mixture of one of these with water and held at moderate temperature until conversion into the thermodynamically stable crystal modification is quantitative, either by holding the suspension or by dissolving the crystals warm and cooling slowly, with or without seeding. The crystals are then separated off and dried to constant weight. Only the crystal lattice changes; the molecule does not.
notes: Solvent-mediated polymorph conversion, [0021] to [0025]. No bond is formed or broken: crystal modifications II and III of tembotrione and crystal modification I of tembotrione are one substance in three lattices, so the same molecule stands on both sides of the arrow. reaction_class is recrystallisation because the operation is dissolution and/or suspension in a solvent followed by crystallisation of a different solid form; no enum value names a polymorph conversion directly, and recrystallisation is the only value that describes what is physically done. mechanism_type is not_determinable because no chemical mechanism operates. TEMPERATURE, recorded as printed and NOT repaired: [0021] and [0022] recite 0°C bis 80°C, and the structured range carries those bounds because they are the ones the invention is defined by and the ones claim 8 repeats. [0024] then prints a preference ladder that is internally inconsistent as published: kleiner 100°C, bevorzugt 0°C bis 80°C, besonders bevorzugt 60°C bis 80°C, ganz besonders bevorzugt 50°C bis 80°C. The ganz besonders bevorzugt band (50 to 80) is WIDER than the besonders bevorzugt band (60 to 80) it is supposed to narrow, so the ladder does not nest. Recorded exactly as printed and flagged here; no listed validation flag covers a defective preference ladder, so it is not silently corrected and not silently dropped. COOLING RATE, second printing defect: [0024] gives Kühlrate kleiner 25°C and kleiner 20°C with NO time unit, where the worked examples at [0055] to [0057] print the same figure as 20°C/h. The general passage is transcribed without the per-hour unit because that is what the page says. TIME: two alternatives are given and a single float cannot hold both, so time_h is null: a suspension converts in a period of 14 Tagen without seed crystals, and 24 bis 48 Stunden is generally sufficient when seed crystals of crystal modification I are used. SEED CRYSTALS: Impfkristalle of crystal modification I are optional material added to the conversion, so crystal modification I appears twice in compounds[], once as the product and once with role additive for the seeding use. The role enum has no seed value; additive is the closest and the seeding use is stated here rather than implied. SOLVENTS: every solvent [0023] lists is carried, although only one would be used in any run. STARTING MATERIAL: [0021] describes the modifications II and III as nach WO 00/21924 erhältlich. That document is not part of this run, so cross_reference_unresolved is set and flagged; it is set on both steps of this section because both consume the same externally sourced material. [0020] IS NOT A STEP: it says tembotrione itself can be prepared by one of the processes named in WO 00/21924 and gives no operation, no solvent and no condition. A record for it would be an invented step, so the section yields two steps and not three. QUANTITIES: the section states no charge, no mass, no volume, no yield and no purity anywhere. Every such field is null and nothing is computed. Step count agrees with A0's estimate of 2. A0 warned A2 might return 1 by declining the grinding route for want of a reaction_class, or 0 by reading the passage as non-procedural; neither was done, the grinding route is emitted as step 2 with reaction_class other. Extraction model: Claude Opus 4.5 via Claude Code.

pressure.qualitative_text: Geeigneter Druck ist ein Druck von mindestens 5 bar (a suitable pressure is a pressure of at least 5 bar); a stated minimum, not a set point

procedure_text: [0026] Die stabile Kristallmodifikation I kann auch durch Mahlen unter hohem Druck aus den Kristallmodifikationen II und III beziehungsweise Gemischen davon erhalten werden. Geeigneter Druck ist ein Druck von mindestens 5 bar.
procedure_summary: The metastable crystal modifications of tembotrione, or mixtures of them, are ground under high pressure, with no solvent, to give the thermodynamically stable crystal modification. Only the crystal lattice changes; the molecule does not.
notes: Solvent-free route to crystal modification I, [0026]: the stable modification is also obtained from modifications II and III, or mixtures of them, by grinding under high pressure, a suitable pressure being at least 5 bar. reaction_class is other, NOT recrystallisation: nothing is dissolved and nothing crystallises from a solution here. It is a solid-state conversion by milling, and no enum value covers it. This is the step A0 predicted A2 might drop for want of a class; it is kept, with the class left honest rather than stretched to fit. PRESSURE: mindestens 5 bar is a stated minimum, not a set point. The printed wording is kept verbatim in pressure.qualitative_text; value_kpa carries the same figure converted to the unit the schema field is defined in, and nothing else was derived from it. No solvent, no reagent, no catalyst, no temperature, no time and no quantity is stated. The section gives no charge, no yield and no purity for this route either. The mill, the grinding time and the atmosphere are all unstated and are left null. The text says unter hohem Druck but makes no safety statement, so safety_notes is empty and no safety tag is emitted; hazard assessment is A5's work, not this pass's. cross_reference_unresolved is carried from step 1: the modifications II and III consumed here are the same material [0021] attributes to WO 00/21924, which is not part of this run. This is the SAME transformation that claim 10 recites; see the Claims section notes. It is one disclosure counted once here and once there, not two.
